Hi Claire — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap + proposed next steps: 

- Recap: you’re evaluating inference economics (latency + cost) for a patient-facing NLP assistant and want to validate latency at 99th pct, token costs, and integration with your VPC deployment.
- Asks from your side: a runbook for data flow, rough cost projection for 100k monthly active users, and a short technical deep-dive where your security and infra folks can join.

Proposed next step: a 60-minute technical deep dive (demo + infra Q&A). I can do the following slots (PT):
- Wed 12/02 10:00–11:00
- Wed 12/02 13:00–14:00
- Thu 12/03 09:00–10:00

Could you pick a slot that works and confirm who from BlueHaven should join (security/infrastructure/product)? I’ll include Marissa (solutions engineer) to run the runtime walkthrough and Karthik for the rollout/POC logistics.

I’ve attached the discovery notes from our call and a one-pager on throughput/cost tradeoffs for quick context.

Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf (summary), redwood-product-one-pager.pdf

Thanks — Rishi
